facts.text: UAlbany houses the nation's first College of Emergency Preparedness, Homeland Security and Cybersecurity, located in the ETEC complex alongside the New York State Mesonet weather-detection system.

sources.title: College of Emergency Preparedness, Homeland Security and Cybersecurity | University at Albany
sources.quote: ETEC is home to UAlbany's first-in-the-nation College of Emergency Preparedness, Homeland Security and Cybersecurity, as well as the Department of Atmospheric and Environmental Sciences, the University's Atmospheric Sciences Research Center and the New York State Mesonet
